overview.description: The First Trust Bloomberg Space Economy ETF (FSPC) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Bloomberg Space Economy index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of companies from around the world viewed to be part of the Space Economy. FSPC was launched on Jul 8, 2026 and is issued by First Trust.
